summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Build a playlist from a file' feature in Songs tab (MusicianDashboard). Logged in as test@test.com, exercised the full interactive flow via Playwright against the public preview URL. All 8 acceptance criteria in the review request pass. Feature is functional end-to-end including modal open, help popover, .lst upload + classify, three-bucket rendering, checkbox toggle, edit-and-rematch with Undo, commit, and idempotency hint.

issues: Success toast after commit was not visually observed in the automation snapshot (modal did close and song count updated 19->21). Toast may render/disappear very quickly. Non-blocking; recommend main agent optionally verify manually or increase toast duration for accessibility.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~16.6k lines; the new import feature is spread across many locations (state ~L2081, handlers ~L3890, modal JSX ~L6321, dropdown ~L6910). Strongly recommend extracting the PlaylistFileImportModal into its own component/file for maintainability.

The 'you edited this, and it matched a song already in your library' note is only visible when the collapsed <details> is expanded; consider auto-expanding briefly or moving the note outside <details> so users notice the edit result without extra clicks.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /tmp/lst/import_*.lst files with 'Auto Import Playlist ...' names. Two new songs may have been added to the test library ('BrandNewImportSongZ_*' and 'EOF') plus two 'Auto Import Playlist ...' playlists created. Ignore/cleanup at will.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified flows: (1) Manage Songs dropdown -> open-playlist-file-import-btn opens modal; (2) help-toggle shows help panel with copy button; (3) .lst upload + Read file yields resolve view with prefilled name and three live count tiles (import-count-linked/adding/needs); (4) exact library match ('Test Song 1' / 'Artist A') lands in collapsed 'Already in your library' (import-linked-summary); (5) brand-new lines render as blue import-add-row-{i} with checkbox and Edit; (6) unchecking import-add-check-{i} decrements adding count and commit-button 'Create playlist with N songs' label (verified 2->1); (7) editing an add row to exactly match an existing library song ('Test Song 2' / 'Artist B') moves it into the linked group with 'you edited this, and it matched a song already in your library' note + import-linked-undo-{i}; (8) Undo restores the row back into the add group; (9) commit closes modal, refreshes song list (19->21), no error; (10) re-uploading the same .lst with unchanged line-1 name shows the amber hint 'A playlist with this name already exists, so it will be updated, not duplicated.' No console errors of concern (only React Router v7 future-flag warnings).
